title: Academic calendar 2026-27
summary: Semester start and end dates, breaks, final exams and commencement.
body:
Semester start and end dates, breaks, final exams and commencement.

Fall 2026

  • Classes begin: August 31
  • Fall break: October 12 to 13
  • Thanksgiving break: November 25 to 29
  • Final exams: December 14 to 18

Spring 2027

  • Classes begin: January 19
  • Spring break: March 15 to 19
  • Final exams: May 10 to 14
  • Commencement: May 22

title: Spring 2027 advising checklist
summary: What to finish before you meet your advisor about spring classes.
body:
What to finish before you meet your advisor about spring classes.

Before your advising meeting

  • Review your degree audit in the student records system
  • List five to seven courses you want, plus backups
  • Check prerequisites and holds on your account

At the meeting

  • Confirm your plan for the major and any minor
  • Ask about research, internships or study away

After

  • Watch your email for your enrollment time

title: Faculty handbook digest 2026-27
summary: The short version of policies on teaching load, office hours, grading and leave.
body:
The short version of policies on teaching load, office hours, grading and leave.

Teaching

  • Standard load is three courses per semester
  • Hold at least four office hours each week
  • Post syllabi in the LMS by the first day

Grading

  • Midterm grades due: October 23
  • Final grades due 72 hours after each exam

Leave

  • Sabbatical applications due February 1

title: Grade submission and academic integrity steps
summary: Deadlines for midterm and final grades and how to report an integrity concern.
body:
Deadlines for midterm and final grades and how to report an integrity concern.

Deadlines

  • Midterm grades: October 23 by 5:00 pm
  • Final grades: 72 hours after the exam

Integrity concerns

  • Talk with the student first
  • Submit a short report to the Dean of Students within ten days
  • Keep copies of the work in question
